findings.current: “I figured I should answer the phone, no matter what.”
findings.defect: The omitted subject is resolved incorrectly. Taekyung spared Go Se-won so that Go could answer the call, not because Taekyung himself needed to answer it.
findings.rationale: The following lines directly address what Go Se-won should have told his family, establishing him as the person who needed to take the call.
findings.replacement: “I figured you should at least get to answer the phone.”
findings.source: 아무리 그래도 전화는 받아야 할 것 같아서.

findings.current: “I must have first held a sword more than thirty years ago.
findings.defect: The draft changes the stated duration from thirty years to more than thirty years.
findings.rationale: 삼십 년도 전 identifies the event as occurring thirty years ago; the later 장장 삼십 년 reinforces that exact duration.
findings.replacement: “It must have been thirty years ago when I first picked up a sword.
findings.source: 처음 검을 쥐었던 게 삼십 년도 전일 거야.

findings.current: He had made himself an outlaw and exacted the price for innocent deaths.
findings.defect: The plural “deaths” broadens the specific innocent death being avenged.
findings.rationale: 죄 없는 죽음 is singular and refers in context to Kim Hwajong’s death.
findings.replacement: He had made himself an outlaw and exacted the price for an innocent death.
findings.source: 스스로 무법자가 되어 죄 없는 죽음에 대한 대가를 받아 냈다.

findings.current: “A late redemption arc, is that it?”
findings.defect: “Redemption arc” adds a self-aware narrative trope absent from the source and makes the line sound like quippy meta-commentary.
findings.rationale: 뒤늦은 갱생 bluntly characterizes Go Se-won’s belated reform without invoking storytelling terminology.
findings.replacement: “A late change of heart. Something like that?”

findings.current: My heart sank at the three letters.
findings.defect: The source counts three Korean characters, but the translated sign “Morgue” has six English letters, making the literal count internally false.
findings.rationale: This preserves the immediate impact of seeing the sign without retaining a character count that no longer applies in English.
findings.replacement: At that single word, my heart sank.
findings.source: 그 세 글자에 가슴이 덜컥 내려앉는다.

findings.current:
A beautiful woman with a slender figure, a middle-aged man who looked like a bandit, and a blond foreigner who seemed to have stepped out of a magazine all fell silent.

First, they were startled by the head with no body.

Then, they felt sorrow at the face of the corpse resting peacefully.

Finally, they fell silent at the sight of the young man asleep as though he had collapsed.
findings.defect: The draft makes all three fall silent before the ordered sequence of reactions, then repeats that reaction at the end. In the source, they become speechless only upon finally seeing Taekyung.
findings.rationale: The source deliberately orders their reactions: surprise at Go Jun’s head, sorrow for Kim Hwajong, and final speechlessness upon seeing Taekyung.
findings.replacement: A slender beauty, a bandit-like middle-aged man, and a blond foreigner who looked as though he had stepped out of a magazine were first startled by the disembodied head, then saddened by the peacefully resting corpse, and finally fell silent at the sight of the young man sleeping as though he had collapsed.
findings.source: 늘씬한 체구의 미녀와 산적 같은 중년인. 그리고 화보 속에서 튀어나온 듯한 금발의 외국인은 가장 먼저 주인 없는 목에 놀라고, 평온하게 안식에 빠진 시신의 얼굴에 슬픔을 느꼈으며, 마지막으로 쓰러지듯 잠든 청년의 모습에 입을 다물었다.

summary: The draft is broadly faithful, but it contains two altered factual details, one subject error, and several localized register or wording issues.
